👋🏽 Hello, I'm **Yullie Yang** — a quantitative analyst working at the intersection of **economics, data, and engineering**.

📍 Currently in Boston, MA as a **Quantitative Analyst at CoStar Group**, where I own quarterly credit risk forecasting model releases for commercial real estate portfolios — supporting stress testing, scenario analysis, and model performance review using CMBS and loan-level data.

🛠 Before CoStar, I was a **Data Scientist / Consultant at Guidehouse** (Mar 2024 – Jun 2025), building Python/SQL workflows over multi-source federal financial datasets, developing validation logic for recurring financial and compliance reports, and evaluating Azure-based retrieval workflows for an internal chatbot on financial policy documents.

🏛 In summer 2023 I was a **Graduate Intern with the Federal Reserve Board's Division of International Finance** (Integrated Technology Solutions) — building research-support tools, NLP and prompt-experimentation workflows over economic and regulatory documents, and R-based research visualizations.

🎓 **M.S. in Business Analytics**, University of Maryland, College Park (Dec 2023, 3.7 GPA) · **B.A. in Global Political Economy**, Waseda University, Tokyo (Sept 2022, 3.7 GPA).

💡 I focus on **production-ready research code**: reproducible R / Python pipelines, model validation and QA, stress testing, and forecasting — translating policy-oriented and financial-modeling decisions into versioned, reviewable artifacts.

### Featured projects

+ **[r-macro-trade-commodity-forecast](https://github.com/yullieyang/r-macro-trade-commodity-forecast)** — modular R pipeline pulling FRED macro / trade / commodity series (exports, imports, net exports, oil, GDP, unemployment, rates) into a quarterly panel, with derived measures and ARIMA 8-quarter forecasts.
+ **[cre_stress_test](https://github.com/yullieyang/cre_stress_test)** — supervisory-style commercial real estate stress test pipeline (FRED macro + mobility + zoning data, ~78% recall, FPR ≤20%, 0.73 AUC).
+ **[Predicting Average Housing Starts](housingstarts.html)** — quarterly FRED data + linear regression for 1 / 2 / 4-quarter forecasting.
+ **[Employee Attrition Prediction](employeeattirtionprediction.html)** — KNN / Naive Bayes / Decision Tree / Random Forest comparison with imbalanced-class handling.

### Toolbox

+ **Languages:** R, Python, SQL
+ **Frameworks & tools:** tidyverse, ggplot2, pandas, scikit-learn, Power BI, Azure, Git
+ **Domain:** financial model validation, stress testing / scenario analysis, forecasting, policy research support
+ **AI / LLM workflows:** Claude API, Claude Code, retrieval-augmented document workflows
